name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A short text that shows when the pointer rests on its trigger or the trigger has focus.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import "../core/vitehub.css";
import "./tooltip.css";
import { Tooltip as TooltipRoot } from "@ui-sdk/vue/tooltip";
import TooltipContent from "./TooltipContent.vue";
import type { TooltipEmits, TooltipProps, TooltipSlots } from "./types.ts";

const open = defineModel<boolean | undefined>("open", { default: undefined });
const { defaultOpen = false, delay, label } = defineProps<TooltipProps>();
defineEmits<TooltipEmits>();
defineSlots<TooltipSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <TooltipRoot v-model:open="open" :default-open="defaultOpen || undefined" :delay="delay">
    <slot />
    <TooltipContent v-if="label">{{ label }}</TooltipContent>
  </TooltipRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { TooltipContent as TooltipContentPart } from "@ui-sdk/vue/tooltip";
import type { TooltipContentProps, TooltipContentSlots } from "./types.ts";

const { side = "top", sideOffset = 6 } = defineProps<TooltipContentProps>();
defineSlots<TooltipContentSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <TooltipContentPart data-slot="tooltip-content" :side="side" :side-offset="sideOffset"><slot /></TooltipContentPart>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { TooltipTrigger as TooltipTriggerPart } from "@ui-sdk/vue/tooltip";
import type { TooltipTriggerSlots } from "./types.ts";

defineSlots<TooltipTriggerSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <TooltipTriggerPart data-slot="tooltip-trigger"><slot /></TooltipTriggerPart>
</template>
